U3-err-thread.background_work.en: Your message wasn't sent, because {name} is still finishing work it started in the background. Your message and your pick are kept. Wait for it to finish, then send again.
U3-err-thread.background_work.hi: आपका संदेश नहीं भेजा गया, क्योंकि {name} पृष्ठभूमि में शुरू किया हुआ काम अभी पूरा कर रहा है। आपका संदेश और आपकी पसंद सहेजे गए हैं। उसके पूरा होने तक रुकें, फिर दोबारा भेजें।
U3-err-thread.background_work.note: thread.background_work (host #1349, retryable), with nothing running in the conversation: the composer's line when a message naming another agent (the held plan, SendPrompt.agent) is refused because the conversation's agent may still be working in the background (a command left running, a call in flight, output waiting, an agent starting). {name} is the conversation's agent (Claude, ChatGPT, an agent's own name, else "the agent"). Refused before the message is logged: the words stay in the box and the held agent stays held. The host has no command that stops background work, so the line says to wait. With an answer running: U3-err-thread.background_work.running. Registered under its code's id (registry.tsx's ERRORS). Orchestrator r7611. New
U3-err-thread.background_work.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)

U3-err-prompt.handoff_too_long.en: Your message didn't go to the other plan, because this conversation is too long to hand over. The conversation stays where it is. To ask the other plan, start a new conversation with it and send your message there. To stay, send it here again.
U3-err-prompt.handoff_too_long.hi: आपका संदेश दूसरे प्लान तक नहीं गया, क्योंकि यह बातचीत सौंपने के लिए बहुत लंबी है। बातचीत जहाँ है वहीं रहेगी। दूसरे प्लान से पूछने के लिए, उसके साथ नई बातचीत शुरू करें और अपना संदेश वहाँ भेजें। यहीं रहने के लिए, संदेश यहाँ दोबारा भेजें।
U3-err-prompt.handoff_too_long.note: prompt.handoff_too_long (host #1349, not retryable): the turn of a message that switches agents failed before anything reached the new agent, because the handover would leave it no room; no move happened. The step's row in the conversation says it (the composer's stopped line is only for what Restart mends), and the question goes back into an empty field. Replaces #1349's provisional host words, which told the lawyer to shorten the message or change models. New Registered under its code's id (registry.tsx's ERRORS registers every code as U3-err-<code>).
